Window of size k applied to a sequence: new[j] = sum_{t=0}^{k-1} old[j-t] (where old[t] = 0 for t < 0).

In generating function terms, if old has GF P(x), then new has GF P(x) * (1 + x + x^2 + ... + x^{k-1}) = P(x) * (1-x^k)/(1-x).

= prod_{k=1}^{i+1} (1-x^k) / (1-x)^{i+1}

The product prod_{k=1}^{i+1} (1-x^k) is the (i+1)-th term of the q-Pochhammer symbol.

So dp[j] after processing position i (0-indexed) is the coefficient of x^j in:
prod_{k=1}^{i+1} (1-x^k) / (1-x)^{i+1}

This is related to partitions! Specifically, prod_{k=1}^{i+1} (1-x^k) is the generating function for partitions into distinct parts each at most i+1, with signs.

And 1/(1-x)^{i+1} is the generating function for multisets of size i+1 (or partitions into at most i+1 parts, etc.).
